search_notes.method: Primary discovery via ecosyste.ms packages API (packages.ecosyste.ms) listing all PyPI projects synced 2026-06-25..2026-10-10 (47,715 projects), filtered to first_release>=2026-07-01, GitHub repo created>=2026-06-01, language Python, not fork/archived (11,932 repos). Of these, 1,530 distinct repos with >=2 stars and repo size 40-8000 KB were cloned (blob:none) and checked mechanically: first commit>=2026-06-02 (min author date), has python tests, no compiled sources, >=40 'def test_' , 500-8000 src lines, PyPI earliest upload_time>=2026-07-01 via pypi.org JSON. Also pulled ~990 HN stories (Show HN etc., Jul-Oct 2026) via hn.algolia.com but that route was superseded. Web search, Reddit, pythonweekly and GitHub search/trending were not reachable from the sandbox (403 / API path blocked); PyPI RSS only gives the latest ~40 so was not used beyond a sanity check.
search_notes.caveats: Mechanical pass rate was ~39% because many new PyPI projects are AI-assisted small repos. The 12 selected were manually vetted (README lineage, runtime deps, test imports) from the ~125 mechanical passes that had no lineage flags, no heavy deps, no network libs in tests and >=8 commits. Rejected entries with 'passed mechanical checks' were not individually README-reviewed. Test suites were not run (instruction: only git and curl). Stars>=2 prefilter means very new zero-star repos were not examined.
